title: Magnified ruler picker and rolling digits
blurb: Rebuild Nitish Khagwal's Ruler Picker inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas: a cylindrical glass lens magnifies datalist ticks around the thumb while output digits roll like an odometer drum.
question: Can a real semantic <input type="range"> paired with a <datalist> tick scale inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas produce a smooth cylindrical glass magnifier lens where ruler ticks swell and refract under the thumb while <output> digits roll like a mechanical odometer drum, all while remaining directly draggable, keyboard-accessible (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight), and screen-reader native?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 6/6 live checks pass (0.86 MP, 6.9 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625); one ElementGL canvas magnifies datalist ticks through a cylindrical glass lens while rolling output odometer drums smoothly across digit wraps. Real Android hardware stays not verified.
